scoringEmphasis.direct: Hands-on inspection, CMM and gauge work, NCRs, 8D corrective action, and calibration control.
scoringEmphasis.transferable: Measurement or documentation rigor from production and machining roles.
scoringEmphasis.adjacent: Lean or process work that touches quality outcomes, such as setup reduction or SPC.
scoringEmphasis.impact: Escape rates, inspection time, NCR closure rate, and customer returns.

header.label: QUALITY TECHNICIAN
header.guidance: Lead with the current inspection role and name the main tools (CMM, SPC, 8D) in one line.

scoringEmphasis.direct: Kaizen events, 5S, setup reduction, value-stream work, and measured process changes.
scoringEmphasis.transferable: Root-cause and corrective-action work from quality roles, SPC and data analysis.
scoringEmphasis.adjacent: Shop-floor production experience and training others on new methods.
scoringEmphasis.impact: Setup time, scrap rate, throughput, and hours saved per month.

header.label: CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT TECHNICIAN
header.guidance: Frame quality work as process improvement, leading with measured before-and-after results.
